note: Same identity for compactly supported frequency tests: boundary Fourier transform equals the strict-height psi of the exponentially multiplied test (lifts = exp(<y,x>) f). [L] writes the Fourier convention with Distn.fourier, Probe.hat and lifts rather than [M]'s b-hat_+(-.) and e^{sum y_j p_j^4}; the sign and normalization conventions were not matched symbol by symbol.

def during (F : Waves S) (W : Surface S) := ∀ (n : ℕ) (v : Fin n → S.Union) (y : Heights n), y∈east n→ ∀ f : Joint n, ∀ h : HasCompactSupport ⇑f,
    Distn.fourier (W.W n v) f=F.psi v y (Probe.hat (lifts (dawn y) f h))
